summary:
Second review of w126 after the person's answer. It covers the same single implementer commit, 97a0cec (work request, requests r1-r5), found between the claim and done commits because the branch work/w126 is gone. No code changed for w126 after the first review.
No change under features/. No test is removed or weakened. The allowances say none, and that holds. The 10 requests scenarios pass. size: no file over 300.
r1-r5, the Purpose and decisions 0055 and 0067 hold. No code was found that no line asks for.
The earlier fix-now finding (a missing --lines file gives a traceback) was answered on 2026-10-24: accept as it stands and deliver it later through a work-queue#r7 row and its own fix work-item. It is not raised again.
Minor observations remain. vulture finds an unused 'named' in the origin step, which asserts fixed values, so tools check exits 1. --source with --thread drops the sources. An empty lines file writes a request with no lines. A newline in a value goes into the frontmatter unchecked.
